installed_scissor_smoke.scope: Default entry; ALPHA_SCISSOR 0.5 with default depth prepass only, not alpha hash or MSAA acceptance.

limitations: Only the two Forward+ cutout pipeline/shader source files change after candidate07. The 49 previous source files remain byte-identical. Previous native CPU tests were not rebuilt/rerun for candidate08.

Default depth prepass preserves occluder rejection with depth writes disabled in the color pass. Without depth prepass, alpha-discard shaders use late depth testing and hidden geometry may request higher texture detail; rendered occlusion remains correct.
Built-in alpha-scissor/hash feedback moves before built-in clipping. Custom user discard inside FRAGMENT remains earlier and is not fixed by this patch.

Feedback is geometric demand for cutout surfaces, including holes; a genuinely all-transparent surface may now request texture detail. No mip forcing, streaming-budget change or extra render pass is introduced.

Observation tickets record an exact feedback-buffer period, not all future periods. First-frame shader startup may yield a no-demand observation; the reproduction preserves that sample and obtains a separate later observation.
This is a synthetic component correctness test, not a map loading/FPS/low-frame performance claim. Editor alpha71, banner47 and final wind-runtime banner48 GPU/HTTP regressions passed on candidate08.
Automated cutout regression and installed-entry smoke use alpha scissor at threshold0.5. Alpha-hash is affected code scope, not separately rendered acceptance; no all-transparency-mode or MSAA claim.
